description: Partner: Suppatti → Ogguny

name: Kendra Lucutti
description: Partner: Pluruppa → Seeda → Rose Fairy

name: Eternal General Ralphiel
description: He joins the Protectors as their chapter 2 guide often using books and technology to substitute for his lack of magical abilities.

name: Benjy Stone
description: His ancestors were the original founders of the 25 Oracle Stones and their knowledge were passed down to him, although he lacks their magical abilities, he uses his knowledge of history to assist the Protectors throughout Chapters 1 & 2.

name: Jessie Pronen
description: During the beginning of the comics, Jessie was really Serjes in disguise sent to watch over Rizer and befriend him in hopes it would help protect him from danger. In the Manga, Jessie is an actual boy who befriends Rizer throughout Elementary school to high school. At the end of the manga, Jessie reveals his magical abilities and assists Rizer on some stand-alone missions against creatures of Aurelia.

name: Kenzie Adams
description: A little girl who is afraid of the dark forces so much that she has nightmares about them and draws them to perfection. Although she doesn’t show obvious magical talent, it is reveal that her visions might be similar to that of premonitions. She befriends Zara Collins as the two share similar abilities.

name: Nikel Rezen
description: 15 year old Nikel has appeared throughout the comics as a member of the Red Gang that terrorizes the students of Rizer’s high school including getting into several fights with Rizer himself. It is later revealed that he is son of a general who’s main goal is to hunt down Aurelians and control them.

name: General Hodges Rezen
description: Father of Nikel Rezen, he is a general whom in the comics hunts down Aurelians during chapter 3 in hopes to find out more about their world and destroy any plans they may have to take over the Earth. He hates creatures and sends several armies to evade Aurelia through mass portals and doorways created by technology. He is often considered chapter 3 villain however in the manga and later at the end of chapter 3 it is discovered that he is taken his orders from a little boy who appears to be Loki.

name: Water Made
description:
Appearance: Aquatic bodied female w/pearl on chest

The Water Made uses moisture and liquid around it as attacks. The pearl on its chest is a gift from Crochen, the pearl can omit powerful forces of water that can defeat its enemies regardless of its type advantage.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Death; Level: Enrage

name: Sancktun
description: This mutant fish lives low near the oceans seabed; it dislikes sunlight and often glows brightly when entering into the sunlight.

name: Steel Fishock
description: Created long ago by engineers, this steel covered fish’s true body is unknown and is said to be acidic.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Metal; Level: Battle

name: Triton
description: Appearance of Triton, the greek god. When the original god Triton, left his post, he created a holographic image of himself. Overtime this image became real because of its exposure to the world, it replaced him and he became the God of the Seas. He is one of the eldest child to Crochen.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Spell; Level: Enrage

name: Kurcher
description:
Appearance: Kracken w/2 tails

A 100 foot demonic fish created by Crochen to protect and serve his kingdom. The creature grows a new body everytime it’s defeated however rarely. Its scales can produce acid like liquid that can melt anything it touches. It is said to destroy this creature, you must destroy its heart and brain, and however both are locked in its giant steel like rib cage.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Shadow; Level: Battle

name: Anailis
description: Giant Whale w/3 eyes. Large 1,000 ton whale that usually lives in large bodies of water, the pendants found on its chest and forehead, usually represent that these creatures are of royal bloodlines; however no proof has shown that they belong to a race of royal figures. Although their size usually means they can’t go many places, they are as fast as sound and can travel the world in matter of hours.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Beast; Level: Battle

name: Eganop
description: Small Fish w/7 eyes. This creepy little fish, shas a brain the size of humans however its other organs are as small as a peanut. Its body is small however its head is large and is known to possess high intelligence and usually live alone and migrates whenever others come near it.

name: Serpush
description: Small Fish w/armor. This fish’s true body was given a shell like armor by scientist hundreds of years ago believing that its scales should be protected because of their useful nourishments.

name: De’ Fush
description: Small Fish w/10 glowing tails. Able to be seen miles above the ocean’s surface, these glowing fish were guides to sailors and pirates in the early 13th century and has since been use as moving light towers to those that were lost in the Pacific Ocean. Their home once was near the bays of Lostasia.

name: Atlantian Pirates
description:
Appearance: Pirates w/weaponry

Pirates’ w/weaponry. Elfish like pirates with magical armor weaponry, and immortal like lifespan. Some believe that their great fighting and tracking skills is what makes them very useful allies. Mostly found near the bays of Ancient Lostasia, these pirates once were well known traders in the Pacific Channels.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Soldier; Level: Battle

name: Sapphire Fish
description: Gold fish w/jeweled armor. Living n near deserts, this golden fish has a jeweled incrusted body and can repel numerous of attacks.

name: Zemisite
description:
Evolves from: Sapphire Fish

Silver Fish w/armor & horns. Its giant horns are used as both weapons, shields, and listening instruments. It lives in packs and is the evolve form of Sapphire Fish.

name: Parish
description: Parana’ w/horns, mechanical parts. Parish is part robot and part fish, its horns can also transform into giant guns while the rest of its body is a protecting shield.

name: Lakark
description: Shark w/hindu writing on its body. The hindu writing on its body is believed to be a spell that protects it from magical attacks.

name: La Seral
description: Seal w/armor, small wings. This seal’s wings aren’t useful for flying however it can hop extremely high, usually to avoid attacks.

name: Leperas
description:
Evolves from: La Seral

Walrus w/armor. The evolve form of La Seral, it lost its wings while evolving, but it is still able to hop at the same levels.

name: Serprince
description: Serpent w/hair, spikes. Called the prince of the Atlantic Ocean, Serprince wears a crown like object around its head, representing its status over other aquatic type creatures.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Prehistoric; Level: Ability

name: Oditon, Metal Serpent
description:
Evolves from: Serprince

Serpent w/hair, armor. Evolve form of Serprince, Obiton is a powerful controller of aquatic types. It uses the crown like object to control other aquatic types.

name: Kion, Ocean King
description:
Evolves from: Oditon, Metal Serpent

Serpent w/hair, armor, spikes, small wings, triton. Evolve form of Obiton, Kion possess the power to control water and aquatic creatures, it is about 50ft tall and has small wings that can lift its entire body. Unlike its previous forms, it can fly, although slowly.

name: Orgonos, Lord Of The Seas
description:
Evolves from: Kion, Ocean King

1000 ft Serpent w/triton, big wings, triton, spikes. Evolve form of Kion, standing at 1000 ft, Orgonos is one of the eldest sons to Crochen.

name: Sand Eel
description: Eel w/rock skin, antennae. Unlike most eels, the Sand Eel’s body can produce massive amounts of sand and rock, its body is adjustable and can regenerate at will.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Beast; Types: Geo; Level: Ability

description:
Evolves from: Sand Eel

Giant Red Eel w/armor. Evolve form of Sand Eel, this giant red eel can produce massive sand storms. This creature can live for thousands of years by regenerating its body using the sand around it.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Beast; Types: Geo

description: Jellyfish w/metal armor. With one touch of the electricity provided by the Death Jellyfish, it can cause immediate paralysis or even death.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Beast; Types: Shock; Level: Ability

description:
Evolves from: Death Jellyfish

Giant Jellyfish w/thousands of eyes. Each of its eyes can see different points around it, the pupils on each eye can shoot at least 3,000 volts of electricity.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Beast; Types: Shock

description: Fish w/cannons on back. The Cannon Fish has giant cannons on its back that can shoot massive amounts of bullets all generated from air, water, and fuel found in its body.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Metal; Level: Battle

name: Kaos, Ancient Turtle
description:
Level note: Guardian Of The Earth

Giant Tortoise w/trees and mt. from its back. This giant guardian protected the Earth almost 10,000 years ago and has since slept, mountains, cities, and forests has grown on its back, the cities has since been abandoned since it was awaken.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Geo; Types: Leaf; Level: Extreme

name: Dihniuos, Blessed Dolphin
description:
Level note: Guardian Of The Seas

Giant Dolphin w/jewels on its back, wings, hair. Guardian of the Seas, the protector has a body made of smooth leather like fabric and the glowing jewels and crystals can omit light and beams of energy as attacks.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Shock; Level: Extreme

name: Harpoon Fish
description: Salmon w/harpoons. These small creatures have harpoons on their sides that are used as weapons when being attacked by larger pray.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Shock; Level: Battle

name: Diggy
description: Duck w/armor, steel fist Diggy has giant steel fist that allows it to be a valuable fighter.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Geo; Level: Ability

name: Armored Shrimp
description: Shrimp w/armor, stingers. The Armored Shrimp is small but with its armor, it can almost reflect any attack.

name: Siren
description: Half woman, half mermaid w/long dark hair, demonic claws. The siren is deadly maidens or spirits of the sea. Their cries can lure men into their traps and kill them. Only skilled women can get around their deadly songs.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Shadow; Level: Extreme

name: Mermadic Females
description: Mermaids w/female features (sometimes have armors). Mermadic Females are mermaids that belong to Crochen’s kingdom and arehis daughters, there currently are over 10,000 mermaids living in the world, each resembles the next.

name: Mermadic Males
description: Mermen w/different male features (sometimes w/armor). Opposites of the female mermadic kingdom, the Mermen are usually warriors or leaders in their households; some have warrior armor while others are servants to Crochen.

name: Mermaid Soldiers
description:
----MERMADIC FEMALES or MERMADIC MALES

Female/Male Mermaids w/weapons & armor. Both male and female mermadic kingdom members, these soldiers possess the same physical attributes however with enhanced weaponry, once the armor and weapons are placed upon normal Mermadic members, they evolve into soldiers.

name: Sisho, Ocean Guard
description: Giant Scissor Fish w/triton. Fast fish with scissor like claws and metal bodies, Sisho carries a triton that can unleash massive amounts of aquatic attacks.

name: The Clown Fish
description: Small Rainbow Fish. The Clown Fish is covered in rainbow like patterns that once looked upon can make someone dizzy.

name: Niken
description: Swordfish w/spikes. Niken is very fast fish with giant sword like objects around its body, if touched, Niken blade like scales will start cutting repeatedly until the foe is defeated.

name: Castle Dolphin
description: Dolphin w/steel twin fins. This dolphin carries a castle like structure on its back and a crown like object on its head. It is said that once upon a time, it belong to the royal family of Aurelia.

name: Castle Whale
description: 3 million lbs whale w/castle on its back. The largest creature in  Aurelia, the Castle Whale can’t move very fast however when it does, it creates giant waves and earthquakes along the way. It’s Super Blast Beam can destroy cities with one blow.

name: Devil Ray
description: Stingray w/shock pads on its back. The Devil Ray has giant shock pads on its body that if touched can paralyse the toucher.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Shock; Level: Battle

description: Giant Shark w/rusted rocky metal skin. Coated in hard metal, Shark Tooth’s body is believed to be the product of living in harsh surroundings in ancient times. It body now serves as a protective shield against attacks.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Metal; Level: Battle

description: Half gold fish, mechanical parts, half submarine. Created about 600 years ago, this creature’s body is a submarine however its heart, upper body, and tail are that of different fishes.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Metal; Level: Battle

name: Shining Fish
description: Neon Goldfish. A glowing fish that can blind foes with bright flashing lights.

description: Half Duck, Half Robin. This hybrid duck can use  its giant wings to fly while using its fins to swim both at exteme rates.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Aero; Level: Ability

description: Woman shape made up of water w/eyes, pearl on its chest. Beautiful, fast, and strong is what describes this spirit. In ancient times, the Element of Water protected the oceans, ponds, lakes, and rivers and could be called upon to grant magical properties such as healing and immortality.

name: Altarian Male
description: Centaur w/mermadic features. Stong and brute, this warrior lives deep below the waters and is able to swim at fast rrates. It appears to be the protector of Crochen’s kingdom.

name: Altarian Female
description: Female Centaur w/mermadic features. Although equally stong to her male counterpart, the Altarian Female wishes to better serve royal figures.

description: Sea lion w/glowing scales & aquatic like fire coming from its back as hair. This beautiful creature contains fire like hair that if put out will kill it, luckily for it, only dry sand can put it out as it lives in water and is immune to it.

Prehistoric type: Serpent

name: Chiwen
description: Similar appearance to the Chiwen of Chinese mythology. Its body is made of mysterious form of gold & diamond. This mysterious creature travels the oceans in providing gold and diamonds to surrounding cities that worships it. Where it is from and what the limits of its powers are currently unknown.

name: Startrio
description:
Appearance: Three star fishes attached to each other w/one eye from each & gold plated body

These three body fish appears as star fish and share one mind, their organs are constantly moving about within them to keep them alive. It is written that they bring good luck to those who can grab and hold on to them.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Mind; Level: Battle

description:
Prehistoric type: Serpent

Female serpent w/human features & long beautiful orange hair. Eldest daughter to Villa, she is next to claim the throne as Villa, Queen of the Serpents when she comes of age. Although she hates the crown, she flocks to men and orders them to do her bitting like a selfish queen.
options: Types: Aqua; Types: Prehistoric; Level: Battle

name: Villa, Queen Of The Serpents
description:
Prehistoric type: Serpent
Evolves from: Serpentina

Serpentina w/armor, giant staff, long hair, upper human appearance, claws, split sparkling tail, & rings floating around lower body. Ruler of the eastern aquatic kingdom, Villa is direct foe to Crochen; some believe it is because he cheated on her with a young witch which bored many of his creatures. For vengenance she created the first tsunami, it destroyed Atlantis, his precious island.

name: Imperial Ocean Beast
description:
Appearance: Giant sea beast w/body similar to dog & wolf. Hard shell armor on upper body,

Giant sea beast w/body similar to dog & wolf. Hard shell armor on upper body. Massive size beast, Imperial Ocean Beasts are lords of the oceans and its body is covered in electric patches and rock like skin hidden underneath to protect it.

description: Giant bird made of water & partial body armor. A giant bird made completely of water; it is the protector of Crochen’s kingdom. It has vast intelligence, great speed, super strength, and can produce giant balls of water as attacks.

options: Types: Aqua; Types: Beast; Level: Enrage

description: Otter standing upright w/pearls around neck, warrior attire on upper body, gloves, boots. Zimondale is a small fighting otter with weapons and giant pearls that can be used as aquatic attacks.

description:
Appearance: Giant whale w/horns (largest creature of all creatures)

Giant whale w/horns. 2nd largest creature in Aurelia, the Aquawhale can use its body and the water around it as massive attacks. Its body is both partially furry and covered in a smooth leather like fabric.

name: Gangi-Kozo
description: Sea creature w/thousands of antennae’s & fishing rod like object from arms. Gangi-Kozo is a sea creature that can hear and see everything within 100 miles from it with its thousand antennae like objects from its head. The fishing rod like object is used to control water around it.

name: Ikuchi
description: 100ft serpent that curves dripping blood & oil from scales. Ikuchi is a deadly creature that can use its own blood as attacks and oil from its scales to poison its foes.

description: Fish like sea monster w/barb-covered tail. Isonade is a giant sea monster with barbed wired tail and a fence like structure around its body for protection, its giant body can be used as a weapon because it often throws itself using propellent like attacks.

name: Cocodile

name: Aura Guardian Beast
description:
------

-------

The Domi Mages created this beast to protect and watch over Aru, it appeared as a giant beast with glowing markings and patches of light around its body, it was nor good nor evil, its giant horns were powerful and could lift mountains. It has giant wings that can disappear at will, its giant hooves and claws could shoot lightning, it had fangs and its body was the size of current New York City.

name: Abyssinian
description: This smart talking feline uses its charm to latch onto anyone and then releases spores from its hard fur to control enemies with its seductive tone. It is fast and can camouflage itself to blend with any surface.

name: Adeliguin
description: Adelie Penguin, its smooth body can protect it against harsh climates up in the highest mountains of Aurelia. It uses the ice around it to launch fierce Frozen Type attacks.

name: Affenpinscher
description: Small dog like creatures that uses its thick fur to protect it and other from attacks. Its dark eyes can see deep into the darkness.

name: Akbash
description: Loyal creatures that are found in almost all cities and towns throughout Aurelia. They are by far the largest breed of any Anirelian.

name: Alamalamute
description: Alaskan Malamute

name: Aldatoise
description: Aldabra Giant Tortoise

name: Gatorwamp
description: Alligator

name: Albracke
description: Alpine Dachsbracke

name: Anu
description: Ainu Dog

name: Buphant
description: African Bush Elephant

name: Bastelifly
description: Butterfly, sweet and harmless looking butterfly that releases spores when touched that can kill or paralyze opponents instantly.

name: Buttish
description: Butterfly Fish, small harmless fish that has wings of a butterfly and glows with rainbow like strings wrapped around its body. It uses stingers attached to its lower wings to catch preys.

name: Canvet
description: African Civet

name: Clawedrog
description: African Clawed Frog

name: Dodabare
description: A dodo bird whose body is hidden underground. Its long neck and beak can be used to grab things high from trees. Very few people have ever seen its lower body, because of this it is usually pictured as just a neck with a head and connected feathers from its head.

name: Doglidare
description: A loyal hound that will connect with its battler from birth and remain with him until death. It uses its long tail to wrap around objects it cares about.

name: Forest Elephant
description: African Forest Elephant

name: Guboriloo
description: Gerbil, its small body can conduct about a power plant worth of electricity each time it rubs its tail against a static like surface.

name: Jigantaclam
description: Giant Clam, its large clam like body produces light that light sailors across the dark sea. Its small orb like body glows bright when it is ready to attack.

name: Nightmarig
description: Giraffe, using its piercing deep eyes, it can use the lines around its body to hypnotize others and even control their dreams with its tail using the face like object that smiles when it is in someone’s dreams and frowns when it is in someone’s nightmares.

name: Glassizard
description: Glass Lizard, a lizard made up of glass that can reflect any type of attack. Its large flat tail is used to repel poison and its large glowing eyes can block mental attacks.

name: Glerm
description: Glow Worm, intelligent glowing worms that holds the knowledge of almost any region, however they live under the ground and dig cities beneath cities. Using their intelligence they have been known to be assistance to many leaders throughout the world.

name: Summarohn
description: Goat, its golden pulled back horns were once used to make gold across Aurelia. Its large hooves can stomp through a hard force with ease.

name: Localus
description: Golden Retriever, one of the most common creatures throughout Aurelia. Usually found rounding up numerous wild creatures in the plains of Aurelia. Loyal to their deaths, they can locate anything anywhere and at anytime with little to no scent. Using the charms around its neck it is protected against all known spells.

name: Luckiloose
description: Goose, considered luckily because of its shedding fur coats that light up like a rainbow when it gets wet. This creature are found in hoards and can usually seen singing sweet lullabies to smaller creatures near it.

name: Littel
description: Gopher, these small creatures aren’t very powerful and only know one attack “Earth Smear” but they are found in groups of thousands ranging from different sizes, shapes, and colors. They sometimes can even speak normal language if taught.

name: Jungalape
description: Primeape, smaller versions of Kingolus that move and act to its every command. They worship their king to the point of doing anything it wants. They grown in size when angered and is shielded by armor made from the earth. Their brisk bodies can also shrink in size to multiply themselves when under attack.

name: Kingolus
description: Gorilla, massive in size, it wears a crown made up of crystal and hard mud. Its body is rough and hard as a diamond shell. Once a ruler of the primal jungles of Aurelia, Kingolus lost most of its power when new cities threatened its kingdom.

name: Hanhound
description: Afghan Hound

name: Pacanvet
description: African Palm Civet

name: Oletero
description: Panther, a golden panther capable of commanding the mightiest of creatures with its roaring screams. It lives deep within the Black Forest and serves as its guardian during times of great distress.

name: Master Parrotos
description: A giant multicolored parrot that although quite large, can fly faster than the wind and produce great loads of wind behind it. In ancient times, it kept the Sky Kingdom afloat on its back.

name: Prina the Peacock
description: Using the different eyes on its tails, it can see deep within the world in all directions. Its two main eyes are always looking into the future, using the eyes on its feathers to see its opponents and all around itself.

name: Platinine
description: Platypus, a platypus with nine longated tails and a fiery temper, it can move very quickly in the water and gain the power to move the earth while on land.

name: Snuffels
description: Pitbull, this little guy may appear weak and its attacks are not as strong but it takes a liking to fighting early on. Constantly bullied by its older forms at times, it can evolve into royalty of its kind.

name: Prinbull
description: Pitbull, gaining massive strength and a mean attitude, this loyal pitbull gains strength in its physical attacks and the Royal Arm ability allowing it to control others will at various moments in battle.

name: Kinbull
description: Pitbull, the crown like object on its head resembles a sense of power, however it really holds its energy that it can release during battle to knock out an opponent.

name: Abyssimolbull
description: Pitbull, standing upright with armor and decorated with a royal like appearance, this massive strength that it gains holds all the courage that it gained since its first form Snuffels.

name: Spindle
description: Porcupine, with sharp pointy blades coming from its body, this creature is a thing of habit by releasing his blades to latch onto objects and then drain them of their energy with the same spikes.

name: Rabbit King
description: Wearing a big crown, a staff, and royal attire, this creature is the controlling entity to all bunny and rabbit creatures in Aurelia. It uses this position to maintain order throughout the southern Anirelian Court.

name: Safariguin
description: African Penguin

name: Tropper
description: African Tree Toad

name: Wilbark
description: African Wild Dog

name: Wingerrier
description: Airedale Terrier

name: Wolmoth
description: Woolly Mammoth, a large tusk mammoth that moves slowly but has a fur like shield strong enough to protect it against any foe. It is usually seen in a pack, if one strays away, it can become dependent on the first thing it sees.

name: Wolking
description: Woolly Monkey, its large fists and small feet are a matter of being able to move very fast on land and able to wrestle even mountain size predators to the ground.

name: Labridasse
description: Wrasse, a large collection of rainbow colored fish that act as one body. Each fish glow in decorated designs and colors to help keep its predator in a glance. They move and act as one and thus are considered one fish. It is said that they are usually a school of 300 clustered together. If necessary, they can omit a light that makes it appear as one fish.

name: Prisra
description: X-Ray Tetra, this small fish’s body is so transparent that it is often called the ghost of the water. Its body releases bioenergy that is used to see through objects, also known as X-rays.

name: Yakityak
description: Yak, a constantly moving beasts that can carry a ton on its back or up to 5 tons by pulling it. Long ago, this creature was used by thousands across the mountains for its strength. One headbutt and this creature and KO any known fighter.

name: Yellguin
description: Yellow-Eyed Penguin, a loud mouth penguin that uses its large mouth to make the ground burst into pits of rage. Its glowing yellow eyes are said to have become this color by absorbing to much negative energy.

name: Shirerrier
description: Yorkshire Terrier, small but proud, Shirerrier are known as loyal creatures until they are betrayed and at this moment they become obsessed with revenge.

name: Zetaborg
description: A robotic ark like creature capable of carrying a vast population within it.

name: Zebrock
description: Zebra Shark, a fast moving predator that uses the ocean floor to attack prey from below. Its body is smooth enough to allow it to squeeze through almost any surface.

name: Zotal the Zebu
description: Controller of the Aurelian Plains, this massive creature has a scarf like pouch around its neck that can release massive amounts of energy strong enough to blasts through a mountain.

name: Zonkata
description: Zonkey, this creature moves very slowly despite its zebra and donkey mixbreed. It’s body is composed up of gases that can be used to clean dirty air.

name: Zorfelix
description: Zorse, a zebra and horse hybrid that can disappear when light hits its body. Its long mane can be used to blind opponents by becoming a dense fog like substance.
